groups.name: Play
groups.profile: Established double-extortion RaaS, tracked since 2022-11-26; Latin America-origin, now global.
groups.sectors: Financial Services, Healthcare, Professional Services, Retail & E-Commerce, Technology, Transportation

groups.name: The Gentlemen
groups.profile: RaaS since mid-2025 (tracked since 2025-09-09); 320+ claimed victims across 17+ countries, 90% affiliate split, Go-based locker hitting Windows/Linux/NAS/BSD.

groups.name: Whitearmor
groups.profile: Brand-new DLS, tracked only since 2026-10-20 (about a week old); no public profile yet. Also posted a self-promotional Telegram link today (excluded as non-victim, see Non-victim postings).

groups.name: Crypto24
groups.profile: RaaS surfaced on the RAMP forum mid-2024 (tracked since 2025-04-08); targets financial services, healthcare, manufacturing and tech across Asia, Europe and North America.

groups.name: Qilin
groups.profile: Golang-based RaaS, tracked since 2022-10-08; multiple encryption modes, double extortion.

groups.name: Aurora
groups.profile: Associated with a multi-purpose Go-based malware/infostealer-botnet sold under the same name since 2022; tracked as a ransomware brand since 2026-04-29.

groups.name: Byod
groups.profile: Very new, tracked since 2026-10-05 (about three weeks old); today's posting was an "update" offering free decryption for hospital-sector devices only.

groups.name: Direwolf
groups.profile: Human-operated locker (Golang, Curve25519/ChaCha20), tracked since 2025-05-22; manufacturing/tech focus, ransoms reported up to $500K.

groups.name: Dragonforce
groups.profile: Major RaaS since August 2023; formal 80% affiliate program, rebranded as a "ransomware cartel" in 2025.
